notes.about: The art brief's keys (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-tactics-interactables-design.md section 4), as the manifest of a new set, content/tactics/base/interactables/manifest.json, in props/manifest.json's shape, so it loads with ArtManifests as it is: each kind's variants are its states (interactables.chest.open = ThingView.Art + '.' + ThingView.State), drawn as one frame each; each transition is an asset of its own, <kind>_<transition>, one strip played once from its first state to its last, then the state holds. Drawn at 1x, shown at 2x, facing sw; the TV mirrors for the other facings. ambient has no art of its own.
notes.anchor: the ground contact pixel; stand it on the tile centre
notes.frames: a transition is a horizontal strip, played once at fps
notes.cover: none | half | full, for ranged attacks (a passage: when closed)
notes.height: in height steps (16 px), for line of sight
notes.layer: absent = over (a billboard, sorted with units); ground = lies flat under units
notes.blocks: a passage's blocks is true and means closed: when open the engine says it doesn't
notes.empty: a pickup's taken and a cache's open draw nothing: the TV isn't sent them, so they may be left out
notes.totals: 29 kinds, 50 state frames, 14 transition strips of 65 frames: 115 frames in all
notes.notice: the notices (tracks, scratches, disturbed_earth, bloodstain, draft, carving, rune, remains) and hidden_path are one state each, drawn only once found: no transition. Ground layer, never in the way.

prompts.tracks: interactables.tracks.noticed, 32x16, anchor [16, 15]: a short trail of fresh animal paw prints (wolf-sized, four toes and a pad) pressed into earth, running diagonally from the bottom-left to the top-right corner of the tile, the prints a shade darker than the ground with a 1 px lighter rim on their top-left edges. No ground colour fill around them: only the prints, so they sit on any terrain. Pixel art drawn at 1x (the TV shows it at 2x), lit from the top-left with hue-shifted 6-shade ramps, no pure black or white (darkest outline #140f1a), selective dark outline, shading in clusters of 2+ pixels, transparent background. Seen from the isometric 2:1 overworld camera; it lies flat on one 32x16 diamond tile and faces sw (towards the bottom left). Keep it subtle: it is a clue the party noticed, so it must read at a glance but never look like something to pick up.

prompts.fx_notice: fx.notice (fx/manifest.json, an effect like fx.poof): 24x24 frames, 6 frames at 12 fps, played once over a notice the moment it's noticed. A quiet glint, not a puff: a small four-point sparkle that grows from one pixel, flares pale clue-blue (#7fc8e8) with a warm centre, and fades out with two specks drifting up. Additive blend, anchored at the tile centre. Until it exists the TV plays fx.poof.
